name: Alessandra Bellini
bio:
Alessandra's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing, but through a deep fascination with the mechanics of engines. She spent her youth dismantling and rebuilding scooters in her father's garage in Bologna, developing an intuitive understanding of mechanical systems. This passion led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which she joined a small engineering firm specializing in automotive components.

Her meticulous approach and problem-solving skills quickly earned her recognition. Alessandra transitioned to motorsport, attracted by the challenges and fast-paced environment. She is known for her ability to diagnose and resolve complex mechanical issues with speed and precision, often working independently to find innovative solutions. Her loyalty to Hitech GP stems from their commitment to pushing the boundaries of engineering, something she deeply admires.

Alessandra is a dedicated machinist with extensive experience. She is an innovator, always exploring new techniques and materials to improve performance. While she is a strong team player, she also values her independence and is comfortable working alone to solve complex problems.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Alessandra is of average height with a strong, determined face and calloused hands that speak to years of working with machinery.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils to an exact point before starting work.
Has a specific set of tools she refuses to let anyone else use.
Mumbles Italian proverbs when deeply focused on a task.
